description: É um jogo educativo que transforma uma viagem da Terra até a Lua em uma experiência de aprendizagem científica.
summary:
LUNARIS is an educational space exploration game in which players take on the role of an astronaut and embark on a journey of discovery through space. Throughout five levels, players encounter challenges and situations inspired by real problems in the space environment, requiring attention, critical thinking, and decision-making skills to progress through the missions. During the experience, players explore topics related to space exploration, orbital debris, sustainability, and the challenges astronauts face while carrying out activities beyond Earth.

The project aims to combine entertainment, technology, and scientific knowledge through an interactive and immersive experience, making learning more dynamic and accessible. In addition to providing entertainment, LUNARIS seeks to spark interest in science, astronomy, and space technologies while highlighting the importance of responsible space exploration. In this way, the game demonstrates how phenomena and events occurring beyond our planet can directly affect life on Earth, encouraging awareness of the importance of preserving the space environment and ensuring a sustainable future for human exploration.
details:
LUNARIS — EXSPACE is an educational and interactive space exploration game set in the year 2045. Players take on the role of the commander of an advanced orbital spacecraft, responsible for completing five scientific missions related to space exploration and the preservation of Earth. Throughout the experience, players receive instructions from the CAPCOM control center and must complete tasks, interpret information, and overcome challenges inspired by real space-related situations and phenomena.

The five missions cover important topics: space debris and its risks to satellites and communication systems; solar storms and radiation; the identification of near-Earth asteroids and planetary defense; the use of satellites for environmental monitoring, including deforestation and water pollution; and responsible lunar exploration, with a focus on planetary protection.

Objectives, Benefits, and Impact

The main objective of the project is to bring science and space technology closer to the public by transforming scientific knowledge into an interactive, accessible, and engaging experience. Its benefits include encouraging scientific curiosity, developing logical reasoning and problem-solving skills, promoting environmental awareness, and helping players understand the relationship between events in space and their impacts on everyday life.

The project's intended impact is to contribute to science education by inspiring students and young people to explore astronomy, space exploration, sustainability, and technological innovation.

Features and Accessibility

The game includes features such as radio communication with CAPCOM, sound effects, synthesized voice in Portuguese, accessibility settings, spacecraft indicator monitoring, and an experience points (XP) system that allows players to unlock historical astronauts as they progress through the missions. Additionally, players can use their browser's automatic translation feature to translate the game's text and content into English, making the experience more accessible to people who speak different languages.

Development and Tools

The project was developed using digital software and tools for planning, visual design, organization, and prototype development. These tools made it possible to create the interfaces, structure the missions, and implement the interactive elements of the game. The result is an interactive digital prototype that can be accessed directly through a web browser.

Creativity and Project Innovation

The project's creativity lies in combining entertainment, space operations simulation, and scientific learning into a single experience, placing players at the center of important decisions. The concept transforms scientific topics into interactive challenges, bringing players closer to important issues involving space, technology, and sustainability.

Methodology and Teamwork

The project was developed by the EXSPACE team through collaborative planning, division of responsibilities, scientific research, interface design, mission development, and prototype creation. The project aims to demonstrate that learning about space also means understanding the challenges involved in protecting our planet and securing humanity's future on Earth.
